Maya: quick async standup — onboarding phoenix-v1
- yesterday: finished model quant + conversion, ran smoke generation across 200 samples
- blocker: noticed a regression on date/span extraction in the eval suite (f1 0.92 -> 0.84) after kv-cache behavior changes
- today: rerun eval with kv-warmup and compare old quant profile; will open PR if prompt tweak helps

Jonathan: can you paste the smallest failing case?

Maya: minimal repro below (sanitized):
```json
{"input": "List events in Jan 2024", "expected_spans": ["Jan 2024"]}
```
metric drop observed on that exact case and ~12 others in the promptset.

Sophia: re: kv-warmup — on llama3 we used `--kv-prefetch=1` and it fixed a similar drift. Also try `batching_threads=2` for stable latency during evals.

Li: I'll shadow-run the old quant profile and the new one overnight, compare token-level diffs. pinged you on PR #482 for the harness change.

eng-bot: infra deploy applied: infra/kv-cache v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 by @infra-team at 2026-03-18T09:12:00Z :white_check_mark:

Jonathan: quick CR ping @Maya — in prompt change pls escape `\n` in the system message, small nit.

Maya: ack, pushing a one-line fix to escape sequence now, will kick off nightly eval.

Li: if regression remains after your patch, I'll run a diff with `tools/eval/compare_profiles.sh old.json new.json` and attach token diffs.

Sophia: I'll also rerun the canonical promptset with temp seeds [0.0, 0.3, 0.7] to rule out sampling noise.

Maya: thanks — no other blockers. will update here when nightly finishes (should be ~3am UTC). :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Jonathan: thx!
